entries.meaning: a word for a person, place, or thing

example_sentences.sentence: Every noun in this sentence names a person or thing.
example_sentences.sentence_ipa: /ˈɛvɜriː ˈnaʊn ɪn ˈðɪs ˈsɛntəns ˈneɪmz ə ˈpɜrsən ˈɔɹ ˈθɪŋ/

example_sentences.sentence: Can you find the noun that refers to a place here?
example_sentences.sentence_ipa: /ˈkæn ˈjuː ˈfaɪnd ðə ˈnaʊn ˈðæt ɹəˈfɜrz ˈtuː ə ˈpleɪs ˈhiːɹ/

entries.example_sentence: After running in the heat, his thirst was so strong that he drank three glasses of water.
entries.sentence_ipa: /ˈæftɜr ˈɹʌnɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈhiːt ˈhɪz ˈθɜrst ˈwɑz ˈsoʊ ˈstɹɔŋ ˈðæt ˈhiː ˈdɹæŋk ˈθɹiː ˈɡlæsəz ˈʌv ˈwɔtɜr/
entries.meaning: the feeling of needing to drink

example_sentences.sentence: His thirst grew after hours of work in the hot sun.
example_sentences.sentence_ipa: /ˈhɪz ˈθɜrst ˈɡɹuː ˈæftɜr ˈaʊɜrz ˈʌv ˈwɜrk ɪn ðə ˈhɑt ˈsʌn/

example_sentences.sentence: Cold water quickly satisfied his thirst after the long run.
example_sentences.sentence_ipa: /ˈkoʊld ˈwɔtɜr ˈkwɪkliː ˈsætəˌsfaɪd ˈhɪz ˈθɜrst ˈæftɜr ðə ˈlɔŋ ˈɹʌn/
